title: US will soon announce root cause behind FAA nationwide ground stop
summary: Former FAA insider on reducing the risks of upgrading a decades-old network.
llm_summary: The U.S. government is preparing to reveal what triggered the FAA’s recent nationwide ground stop that halted thousands of flights. A former FAA insider explains that the incident stemmed from a flaw in the agency’s aging air‑traffic‑control network, and outlines steps—such as incremental upgrades
